entries.text: DMG Reduction Doctrines — infantry-focused alt. Filler.

doctrines.note: Veterancy: OP defers entirely to 'the graph under the post' (a follow-up post by @JayJayAyh, 2026-05-24, an 'EU1 8.5K+ graph') — graph image not transcribed at capture, so veterancy split is not captured in text form here; not fabricated. 'Origin' and 'Don't put' are literal X placeholders in the OP. Example build (cav-focused) per OP: Lancastrian Billmen Unique Doctrine 1, Lancastrian Billmen Unique Doctrine 2, Unit Damage Doctrine V, Anti-Cavalry Doctrine, Anti-Cavalry Doctrine (second) or Epic Leadership Doctrine; cav-focused build uses 2x Cav DMG Reduction doctrines, inf-focused build replaces slots 1-2 with Bloodthirsty / Mobility / DMG Reduction doctrines. Playstyle: they indeed got buffed (per OP, referring to a prior balance pass, not necessarily Chaos) — huge bleed dmg, survive a bit more now; play like any pikes (play around your Stalwart or any current-meta shield); make sure to be braced when cav arrive; never move formation while fighting or you lose all dmg; use the 2 on cooldown, you stay braced during it (press 2 is a huge burst). Edit timestamp (2026-05-26) pre-dates the 2026-06-25 Chaos patch anchor; doctrine/build guidance flagged for revalidation (Lancastrian Billmen is not on the 13-unit Chaos shortlist, so staleAsOfPatch not forced, noting pre-patch authorship per instructions).
